up: Retrieve distinct molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1240409'. Join the docs table to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and finally to compound_structures on molregno. Return the following columns: molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, molecule_dictionary.max_phase, molecule_dictionary.molecule_type, and compound_structures.canonical_smiles. Sort the results by molecule_dictionary.chembl_id in ascending order. Use SELECT DISTINCT to ensure each molecule appears only once.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1240409' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC
